data.name: MenuLanguagePair
data.comment: Menu item. Lists the language pairs (bundles) on the phone, to switch to another.

data.name: MenuAddBundle
data.comment: Menu item, and the last choice in the language-pair list. A bundle is one language pair's translation data.

data.name: MenuRemoveBundle
data.comment: Menu item.

data.name: MenuTraceMode
data.comment: Menu item that turns trace mode on and off. The app adds a check mark after it when it is on. The trace itself is shown in English.

data.name: ClearHistory
data.comment: Menu item, and the title of the question it asks. Deletes the current language pair's earlier translations.

data.name: MenuLanguage
data.comment: Menu item. Chooses the language of the app's menus and messages (not of the translations). The app puts a globe before it, so it can be found by someone who can't read the language it's in.

data.name: LanguageTitle
data.comment: Title of the list of UI languages. The languages are listed by their own names (English, Español, Français, Deutsch).

data.name: SameAsPhone
data.comment: First choice in the list of UI languages: use the phone's language.

data.name: SourcePlaceholder
data.comment: Grey hint in the empty text box.

data.name: Translate
data.comment: Button. Keep it short: it shares a line with the language pair.

data.name: Translating
data.comment: The Translate button's text while a translation runs.

data.name: TranslatingSeconds
data.comment: The Translate button's text while a translation runs in trace mode. {0} = the seconds so far.

data.name: Earlier
data.comment: Heading over the list of earlier translations.

data.name: EditAgain
data.comment: Swipe action on an earlier translation: puts its source text back in the text box. Keep it short.

data.name: Delete
data.comment: Swipe action on an earlier translation, and a button.

data.name: Cancel
data.comment: Button.

data.name: Ok
data.comment: Button.

data.name: Replace
data.comment: Button: replace the bundle on the phone with the one in the zip.

data.name: Remove
data.comment: Button: remove the bundle from the phone.

data.name: Loading
data.comment: Status line while the app starts.

data.name: LoadingPair
data.comment: Status line while a bundle loads. {0} = the language pair, e.g. "French → Spanish".

data.name: PairDidNotLoad
data.comment: Status line when a bundle failed to load. {0} = the language pair; {1} = the reason, in English.

data.name: NoBundle
data.value: No bundle: tap to add one
data.comment: Status line when the phone has no bundle. Tapping it offers to add one.

data.name: ReadingBundle
data.comment: Status line while a bundle zip is unpacked.

data.name: Copied
data.comment: Status line for a moment after a translation is copied.

data.name: ChooseBundleZip
data.comment: Title of the file picker.

data.name: BundlesTitle
data.comment: Title of an error message.

data.name: PackagedUnpackFailed
data.value: The app's bundles couldn't be unpacked: {0}
data.comment: Error message. {0} = the reason, in English.

data.name: LanguagePairTitle
data.comment: Title of the list of language pairs.

data.name: AddBundleTitle
data.comment: Title of an error message.

data.name: UpdateBundleTitle
data.comment: Title of a question.

data.name: UpdateOlderQuestion
data.value: This {0} bundle ({1}) is older than the one on the phone ({2}). Replace it anyway?
data.comment: Question. {0} = the language pair; {1} = when the zip's bundle was exported and {2} = when the phone's was, each from Exported or ExportedUnknown.

data.name: UpdateNewerQuestion
data.value: Update {0}? The bundle on the phone: {1}. This one: {2}.
data.comment: Question. {0} = the language pair; {1} = when the phone's bundle was exported and {2} = when the zip's was, each from Exported or ExportedUnknown.

data.name: Exported
data.comment: When a bundle was exported. {0} = the date and time.

data.name: ExportedUnknown
data.comment: Used in place of Exported for a bundle whose export date isn't known.

data.name: RemoveBundleTitle
data.comment: Title of the list of bundles to remove, and of its questions.

data.name: OneBundleMustStay
data.value: One bundle must stay on the phone. Add another before removing this one.
data.comment: Message when the phone has only one bundle.

data.name: RemoveQuestion
data.comment: Question, when the bundle has no translations in the history. {0} = the language pair; {1} = Exported or ExportedUnknown.

data.name: RemoveQuestionOne
data.value: Remove {0} ({1}) from the phone? Its one translation in the history will be deleted too.
data.comment: Question, when the bundle has exactly one translation in the history. {0} = the language pair; {1} = Exported or ExportedUnknown.

data.name: RemoveQuestionMany
data.value: Remove {0} ({1}) from the phone? Its {2} translations in the history will be deleted too.
data.comment: Question, when the bundle has two or more translations in the history. {0} = the language pair; {1} = Exported or ExportedUnknown; {2} = how many translations.

data.name: ClearHistoryOne
data.comment: Question, when the language pair has exactly one translation. {0} = the language pair.

data.name: ClearHistoryMany
data.comment: Question, when the language pair has two or more translations. {0} = how many; {1} = the language pair.

data.name: TranslationFailed
data.value: The translation failed. Turn on trace mode to see why.
data.comment: Shown in red in place of a translation that failed, when trace mode is off. In trace mode the reason is shown instead, in English.

data.name: NotAZip
data.value: This file isn't a zip file. Choose the zip of a bundle (export-bundle's Output\ftt_bundle folder).
data.comment: Error message after choosing a file. export-bundle is a command name and Output\ftt_bundle a folder name: leave both as they are.

data.name: NotABundle
data.value: This zip isn't a bundle: it has no readable manifest.json naming a work project, at its top level or in one folder. Zip export-bundle's Output\ftt_bundle folder.
data.comment: Error message after choosing a zip. manifest.json is a file name, export-bundle a command name and Output\ftt_bundle a folder name: leave them as they are.
